content: My projects include interactive installations, data exploration and visualizations, and creative coding projects.

projects.title: MEDITATION ON MATTER
projects.short_description: Installation at Roskilde Festival 2025. Drift through a living collage of textures and tones: whispers of soil, rustling leaves, distant water – field recordings and 3D scans gathered from real landscapes and arranged into an ambient world of stillness and growth.
projects.description: An audiovisual journey into the rhythms of plant life. Step into the Roskilde Festivals GROW garden and leave the noise of the festival behind for a moment. Meditation on Matter invites you to slow down and reconnect with your senses through a guided audiovisual meditation inspired by the quiet intelligence of plant life and all that sustains it. Drift through a living collage of textures and tones: whispers of soil, rustling leaves, distant water – field recordings and 3D scans gathered from real landscapes and arranged into an ambient world of stillness and growth. Taste the garden’s offerings, sip herbal tea, and let your awareness settle into the present. Forget your FOMO. Bring a friend, breathe deeply, and return to the grounding rhythm of simply being.

projects.title: POSER
projects.short_description: Inspired by the DIY spirit of communities in Seattle, this tools seeks to make it easy to share events with your friends spottet in the urban environment using an opensource foundation.
projects.description: Where do you go to meet people and submerge yourself in culture, when you are in a new place? This project encourages the act of staying present while walking around your local area, noticing any community efforts, potlucks, park meetups, concerts or other gatherings while making it easy to organize and share with friends. You go from poster -> picture -> shared calendar event in a few minutes.

projects.title: URBAN FREQUENCIES
projects.short_description: Application developed for Copenhagen Architecture Biennale. Through satellite imagery, climate indicators, and spatial analytics, six thematic maps construct a chronological narrative—from the subtle pulses of air and heat to the physical imprints of urban expansion and ecological presence.
projects.description: This project reimagines environmental data as architectural storytelling. Through satellite imagery, climate indicators, and spatial analytics, six thematic maps construct a chronological narrative—from the subtle pulses of air and heat to the physical imprints of urban expansion and ecological presence. Each map transcends its technical function, becoming a spatial artifact that invites viewers to interpret the city as a dynamic, living organism in flux.

projects.title: CYBERDECK
projects.short_description: In this project I want to use technology in order to transform my own toy hairbrush with mirror as a representation of deeply rooted norms and gendered expectations  of beauty into a device about connectivity and community as an antithesis to our collective addiction and isolation.
projects.description: As technology is continuously tweaked to elevate user engagement, real addiction has been observed in humans, and recently a legal precedent was set in a US court for the addictive design of Meta and Google’s platforms, whose purported purpose was to connect people. Meanwhile, beauty content is making it more difficult to escape one’s own reflection as it tries to sell invasive ideas of beauty, lengthy routines and expensive treatments to adults and even kids. Grooming and beauty rituals used to be a social event shared in tribes and bedroom chambers. However, now it is done in solitude in front of a screen. The addictive nature of the platforms means that we are  at the mercy of the echos bouncing inside a personalized reflective box and whatever take on natural bodies they nudge us to internalize. In this project, I want to use technology in order to transform my own toy hairbrush with mirror as a representation of deeply rooted norms and gendered expectations of beauty into a device about connectivity and community as an antithesis to our collective addiction and isolation.

projects.title: IDEADOTS 3D-LAB
projects.short_description: Web application for idea generation. Place your ideas in 3D space, connect them, and watch your thought network grow organically as you explore relationships between concepts.
projects.description: Ideadots 3D-Lab is an experimental tool for visual thinking and idea mapping. Place your ideas in 3D space, connect them, and watch your thought network grow organically as you explore relationships between concepts. Whether brainstorming, planning projects, or studying complex topics, Ideadots Lab helps you see connections and patterns that traditional note-taking methods might miss. Dive into your ideas from new angles and discover insights through spatial organization.

projects.title: FLAX IN NORTHERN JUTLAND
projects.short_description: Data analysis and historical research. By analyzing shipping records from 1650 to 1800, we aim to uncover patterns of trade, assess the scale and significance of textile imports, and situate these findings within their broader historical and economic context.
projects.description: This project explores the historical journey of flax as a key commodity in textile production, focusing on its movement from the Baltic region to northern Jutland. By analyzing shipping records from 1650 to 1800, we aim to uncover patterns of trade, assess the scale and significance of textile imports, and situate these findings within their broader historical and economic context. The research will involve meticulous data cleaning and the development of insightful visualizations to illuminate the connections between maritime trade and regional textile manufacturing.
